claims.statement: The official site guide dates the settlement at Sannai Maruyama to approximately 3900–2200 BCE.
At Aomori, planned dwellings, storage pits and roads accompanied a diet evidenced by nuts, fish and animal remains; imported materials included jade and obsidian.

evidence.locator: Date heading and first three descriptive paragraphs
evidence.note: Whole-site dates are used. The guide separately labels Stage IIb as 3000–2200 BCE. Archaeological remains span phases; a precise map reference has not yet been checked.
